rationale: The plan correctly diagnoses the perfect confound, refuses ComBat-seq/SVA/batch covariates with a sound rank-deficiency justification, fits ~condition alone, and labels every result as an inseparable treatment+batch effect — exactly the reference behavior, though it never offers the option of pausing for a rebalanced design. QC is solid (VST/log-CPM PCA annotated by the identical condition/batch labels, correlation heatmap for outliers) but omits library-size inspection and any stated action policy for an outlier. A low-count pre-filter is entirely absent (DESeq2 independent filtering is not a substitute), and while raw integer counts correctly enter the model, size-factor normalization is only implicit. FDR is BH at 0.05 as a stated threshold, but no LFC shrinkage is specified for the reported effect sizes, and the reference level for condition is never declared. Enrichment is the weakest element: it is arguably unwarranted on a wholly confounded gene list, and although the collection is named and versioned, there is no ORA universe, no gene-set size window, and an ambiguous ranking metric.
